title: East of Leisure Town Specific Plan
subtitle: A context lens for a proposed, phased community. Draft-plan geometry is not yet represented here as authoritative GIS; this view keeps that distinction visible.
notice: The Atlas has not received authoritative ELTSP GIS geometry. Existing public GIS layers are shown as context; proposed boundaries, parks, trails, and phases require a published source layer before they are drawn as fact.
